verdict.rationale: Bolt runs a full Node.js environment (npm install, servers, terminal) and integrates Supabase for hosted DB, auth, and edge functions, letting a single prompt spin up both UI and backend data/auth logic (bolt-gh-2/3, bolt-docs-22/27/8); a community report confirms building a working app with a database from prompts (bolt-comm-4). However, a hands-on critique notes backend capability is effectively 'outsourced' to Supabase rather than bespoke generated logic, and users report errors/breakage when backend features are added (bolt-comm-4, bolt-comm-11). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of generating custom server-side business logic (not just Supabase wiring), and stronger independent corroboration of reliable full-stack generation from a single prompt without errors.
